about: What an improver may edit on this harness, declared by the harness itself.

apply.note: DSH resolves the profile root from DSH_HOME, not HOME (measured §186.2): a launcher that sets only HOME makes the patch silently inert while the task still succeeds.

smoke.note: -h prints usage without loading the plugin tree, and --dump-config does not resolve modules, so neither alone is a smoke (§186.1).
